actions.do: sdem agents install — the layer agents learn the impact validation

actions.do: add them to <workspace>/requirements.json with sdem requirements propose

releases.summary: Requirements and risk analysis: a governed requirements registry, evaluation against changes, risk findings.

actions.do: re-run sdem events analyse for validations not yet accepted

releases.summary: Assessments made before an analysis are re-done.

breaking: analysis contract 2: validations not yet accepted must be re-analysed (sdem events analyse) and re-assessed

actions.when: you have validations not yet accepted
actions.do: sdem events analyse <CE-id> … then each layer re-assesses

actions.when: a workspace was filled by copying files after sdem new

releases.summary: Governance hardening: decisions recorded and verifiable by signed commits; current and proposed compliance kept apart.
Release readiness: install and run without a clone; the synthetic example ships in the package.
Published evidence carries no machine identity.
Organisation profiles: your types, attributes, rules, link kinds and names on top of SDEM's metamodel (sdem-profile.json).

actions.do: upgrade — 0.13.0 fixes change sets and mappings for them

releases.summary: Layers a team adds above A1 or below A4, declared in its profile.
Metamodel health and stability: sdem model status | usage | stability, sdem bian impact.

migration.note: a DEPLOYED_ON connection that named A4.InfrastructureComponent gets its record's own type

breaking: DEPLOYED_ON targets only a Node, Device or System Software; a connection to anything else passes with a warning until metamodel 0.9.0

deprecations.do: re-point or supersede DEPLOYED_ON connections to a technology service, interface, network, path, artifact or environment

actions.do: sdem migrate --workspace <dir> --person <you> --dry-run, then without --dry-run, for every workspace

releases.summary: Metamodel 0.8.0: the cross-layer link types reviewed (B1).

releases.summary: sdem types and sdem bian search: know what to write.

actions.do: sdem agents install — adds the sdem-new-design skill and the /sdem-new-design prompt

releases.summary: Create a new design: the guide, the skill and the prompt.

actions.do: before every later upgrade: install the new version side by side and run its sdem upgrade check

releases.summary: The update framework: sdem upgrade check, sdem releases, profiles that state the SDEM they need, the version promise.

migration.note: 0.8.0 → 0.8.1, additive: attribute sources (CA-13) and link citations; a placeholder in a required attribute now fails sdem check (LC-04). 0.8.1 → 0.9.0: a platform's network is a link (RA4-37) — a network's `connects` list becomes those links; a hosting platform on no network is a warning (LC-15); trace and impact follow networks (KG-Q-08)

breaking: sdem check reads TBD, unknown, /TBD or an empty string in a required attribute as missing: an error on an active record — leave the value out and mark the record planned (LC-04)
a change-set update merges by default; give "replace": true for the whole-record replacement (AG-K08)

the link type COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_INFRASTRUCTURE (deprecated in 0.15.0, metamodel 0.8.0) is removed in metamodel 0.9.0: a component DEPLOYED_ON anything but a node, device or system software is refused — re-point or supersede it before upgrading (sdem check reports each one)

deprecations.do: record each platform's network as a link — platform association network (RA4-37); sdem migrate converts the list

actions.do: sdem migrate --workspace <dir> --person <you> --dry-run, then without --dry-run, for every workspace
regenerate them (sdem build, view, dashboard, home) — they now link to each other

releases.summary: Architect experience: Home, dashboard and graph linked; graph status shown; architect tasks; sdem new --explore; the README and the Payments walkthrough rewritten. Then the improvement roadmap (metamodel 0.8.1): placeholders are missing values, natural keys for operations, attribute and link sources, evidence classes, sdem change diff, sdem handback. A platform's network is a link, and a network change reaches what runs on it (metamodel 0.9.0).
